messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm out Fri (Apr 4) 18:00 PDT through Sun 10:00 PDT for a family trip. Need overnight oncall coverage Fri night (00:00–08:00 UTC Sat). Can trade shifts? I'll take a weekday morning in return. Handoff notes below.

maya: Short runbook: watch inference-serving and routing-proxy dashboards (links in #dashboards). Known risk: we have a DB vacuum job Sat 01:00 UTC that historically causes transient latency spikes for long prompts. If you see >500ms p50 on /v1/generate, escalate.

maya: Quick checks:
```
# tail logs
kubectl -n inference logs -f deploy/inference-rt | grep -i error
# check canary
curl -sS https://api.redwood/test-health | jq .canary_version
```

maya: If you need to roll back the canary: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-rt inference-rt=redwood/inference:1.4.1` then hit the rollout monitor.

tom: I can pick up Fri night (UTC). I need someone to cover my Sun 18:00–23:00 UTC slot though. @ken @lia any chance? :slightly_smiling_face:

ken: I can cover Sun evening if tom's ok with a Tue morning swap later. One flag — there's a canary rollout to 1.4.2-rc3 starting Fri 22:00 UTC in dedicated-west. If it breaches the error budget we'll need to trigger fallback to 1.4.1 (maya's command). Watch the deploy bot channel.

oncall-bot: Scheduled job: db-vacuum-runner will start Sat 01:00 UTC. Expect short I/O spike. (id: job/3421)

lia: I can do Sun evening instead of ken, but I need Tue 07:00–11:00 UTC covered. maya would you be able to take that?

maya: I can take Tue morning (07:00–11:00 UTC) in exchange.

tom: Sweet, swapping now. I added this to the oncall rota (calendar invite sent). :thumbsup:

ken: Noted — I'll monitor canary Friday and coordinate with tom on handoff. If alerts hit, please page SRE channel immediately.

maya: Thanks all. Quick checklist I'm leaving in the ticket:
- Restart steps: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-rt`
- Fallback image (1.4.1) command above
- Link to eval set for regression checks: https://redwood/evals/canary-1.4.2
- Escalation: page `#sre` then `#eng-oncall` if paging rules fail

lia: Got it. Marking this as covered in the rota. Have a good trip @maya! :wave:

maya: Thanks — appreciate it. I left my phone on for urgent pages only.

tom: FYI I'll drop a quick note in the deploy bot thread before taking over shift so handoff timestamp is recorded.

maya: Perfect, cheers everyone.
